name: Smart Alt Fixer – Image Alt Text & SEO
author: smartaltfixer

sections.description:
Smart Alt Fixer helps WordPress site owners improve image accessibility and SEO by ensuring that images have meaningful and descriptive alternative text (alt attributes).

The plugin scans the Media Library for images missing alt text and provides automatic generation tools to assist site administrators.

Smart Alt Fixer includes a fully functional local alt-text fallback that works without any external services.
Connecting to an optional external image analysis service can enhance the generated descriptions, but is not required for the plugin to function.

Missing alt text can negatively impact screen reader accessibility and image search visibility. This plugin helps reduce manual effort while supporting accessibility best practices and SEO guidelines.

Key features include:

  • Scan the Media Library for images without alt text
  • Generate alt attributes using a local fallback mechanism
  • Optional enhanced descriptions via external image analysis
  • WooCommerce product image support
  • Bulk processing with background execution
  • Multilingual output based on site language

External Services

Smart Alt Fixer can optionally connect to an external service to generate enhanced image descriptions.

Image analysis is only performed when the site administrator manually initiates a scan or generation action.

Service name: Smart Alt Fixer API
Service URL: https://smartaltfixer.com
Purpose: Optional image analysis and alt text enhancement
Data sent: Public image URLs only
Personal data: No personal or identifiable user data is transmitted or stored

Privacy Policy: https://smartaltfixer.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://smartaltfixer.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-alt-fixer directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Smart Alt Fixer in the WordPress admin menu to scan your Media Library.
sections.faq:
Is Smart Alt Fixer free?

Yes. The plugin works without connecting to any external services and includes a local alt-text generation fallback.
Optional enhanced image analysis may require an external service account.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes. Smart Alt Fixer supports WooCommerce product images and galleries.

When are images sent to an external service?

Only when the administrator manually initiates an optional enhanced generation action.
No automatic background data transfer occurs.
